user.title: Netvue Local
user.description: Use a separately provisioned bridge and RTSP stream. Compatibility is not verified for other models.

discover.title: Discover cameras
discover.description: Select an authorized local interface. One UDP broadcast is sent; replies are not guaranteed. No camera authentication is attempted.

select.title: Select a detected candidate
select.description: Discovery does not establish video compatibility.

manual.title: Configure an existing stream
manual.description: Enter the camera address and an existing stream name. A name does not create a stream or prove the camera association. Only letters, digits, underscores and hyphens are allowed.

confirm.title: Confirm the association
confirm.description: Confirm that {host} is the camera publishing {url}. Continuing probes this RTSP URL and enables periodic probes; a source-on-demand may start. No direct camera connection is made by this integration.

data.confirm: I confirm this association and authorize probing the existing stream

status.title: Stream verification
status.description: RTSP probe result: {status}. An H.264 SDP announcement does not prove decoding or the camera association. A name alone does not create a stream. You can add an unavailable stream.

error.invalid_input: Invalid IP address, display name or RTSP stream name.
error.already_configured: This IP address or RTSP URL is already configured.
error.invalid_interface: The selected interface is no longer available.
error.discovery_failed: UDP discovery failed; check the network or use manual configuration.
error.no_devices: No response. Broadcast discovery is not verified; manual configuration is available.

abort.already_configured: This IP address or RTSP URL is already configured.

init.title: Update camera association
init.description: Current URL: {url}. Enter an existing stream name using letters, digits, underscores or hyphens. This does not create a stream. For an older URL using another port or a nested path, leave the name blank to preserve that URL.

confirm.title: Confirm the association
confirm.description: Confirm that {host} corresponds to {url}. Continuing probes this RTSP URL; a source-on-demand may start. The bridge is not reconfigured.

data.confirm: I confirm the association and authorize probing

status.title: Stream verification
status.description: RTSP probe result for {url}: {status}. H.264 SDP does not prove decoding or the camera association. An unavailable stream can be saved.

error.invalid_input: Invalid IP address or RTSP stream name.
error.already_configured: This IP address or RTSP URL is already configured.

abort.already_configured: This IP address or RTSP URL is already configured.
